senses.en: in or near this place; around here

example.en: There must be a pharmacy hereabouts.
example.zh: 这附近一定有药店。

senses.en: the vocabulary of a language

example.en: Linguists study the lexis of a language as well as its grammar.
example.zh: 语言学家既研究语法，也研究一门语言的词汇。

senses.en: a person who talks too much

example.en: My little sister is a real chatterbox.
example.zh: 我妹妹真是个话匣子。

senses.en: a vowel sound that glides from one vowel position to another, as in "coin" or "house"

example.en: The "oi" in "coin" is a diphthong.
example.zh: coin 中的 oi 是一个双元音。

senses.en: a unit for measuring the proportion of gold in an alloy; 24-karat gold is pure gold
senses.zh: 开（金的纯度单位，24开为纯金）

example.en: The ring is made of 18-karat gold.
example.zh: 这枚戒指是18开金的。

senses.en: nausea felt during a flight, especially in turbulence

example.en: She took a motion sickness pill to prevent airsickness.
example.zh: 她服了晕车药以防晕机。

senses.en: a person or thing that takes the place of another

example.en: For many fans, watching games on TV is a surrogate for being there.
example.zh: 对许多球迷来说，看电视转播是亲临现场的替代方式。

senses.en: acting in place of someone or something else

example.en: The company ran a surrogate test before the full launch.
example.zh: 公司在全面推出前进行了替代性测试。

senses.en: an important religious ceremony, especially in Christianity, seen as a means of divine grace

example.en: Baptism is one of the most important sacraments in Christianity.
example.zh: 洗礼是基督教最重要的圣礼之一。

senses.en: a soft toy bear for children

example.en: The child sleeps with her favorite teddy every night.
example.zh: 这个孩子每晚都抱着她最喜欢的泰迪熊睡觉。

senses.en: a woman's sleeveless undergarment

example.en: She bought a lace teddy at the store.
example.zh: 她在商店买了一件蕾丝连衫衬裤。

senses.en: a feeling of not trusting someone or something

example.en: There is deep distrust between the two countries.
example.zh: 两国之间存在着深深的不信任。

senses.en: to not trust someone or something

example.en: Many people distrust online advertisements.
example.zh: 许多人不信任网络广告。

senses.en: shared by two or more people or groups

example.en: They have a mutual interest in music.
example.zh: 他们对音乐有共同的兴趣。

senses.en: given or done by each person or group to the other; reciprocal
senses.zh: 相互的；彼此给予或做的

example.en: The feeling is mutual.
example.zh: 这种感觉是相互的。

senses.en: fighting between armed forces

example.en: The soldiers were trained for combat.
example.zh: 士兵们接受了战斗训练。

senses.en: to try to stop or reduce something harmful

example.en: The government introduced new laws to combat crime.
example.zh: 政府出台了新法律来打击犯罪。

senses.en: the act of firing a gun or other weapon

example.en: We heard a shot in the distance.
example.zh: 我们听到远处一声枪响。

senses.en: an attempt to score in a sport by kicking, hitting, or throwing the ball

example.en: He took a shot from the edge of the box.
example.zh: 他从禁区边缘射门。

senses.en: a photograph

example.en: She got a good shot of the sunset.
example.zh: 她拍到了一张很美的日落照片。

senses.en: coming after something in time or order; next

example.en: We met again the following week.
example.zh: 我们下一周又见面了。

senses.en: about to be mentioned or listed

example.en: Please read the following examples carefully.
example.zh: 请仔细阅读以下例子。

senses.en: a group of people who support or admire someone or something

example.en: The band has a loyal following.
example.zh: 这支乐队拥有忠实的追随者。

senses.en: to a small or moderate degree; slightly

example.en: The test was somewhat harder than I expected.
example.zh: 这次考试比我预期的稍微难一些。

senses.en: a material, such as silicon, whose ability to conduct electricity is between that of a conductor and an insulator

example.en: Silicon is the most widely used semiconductor in electronics.
example.zh: 硅是电子领域使用最广泛的半导体。

senses.en: a device made from such material, used in electronic circuits

example.en: Modern computers contain billions of semiconductors.
example.zh: 现代计算机包含数十亿个半导体器件。

senses.en: the speed at which a piece of music is played

example.en: The conductor slowed the tempo for the final movement.
example.zh: 指挥放慢了最后一乐章的速度。

senses.en: the pace or rhythm of an activity or event

example.en: City life has a much faster tempo than village life.
example.zh: 城市生活的节奏比乡村生活快得多。

senses.en: a quicker or shorter way of getting somewhere

example.en: We took a shortcut through the park to save time.
example.zh: 我们抄近路穿过公园以节省时间。

senses.en: a quicker way of doing something, especially a key combination on a computer

example.en: There is a keyboard shortcut for saving your document.
example.zh: 保存文档有一个键盘快捷方式。

senses.en: moving forward; continuing in space or time

example.en: The journey continues onward through the mountains.
example.zh: 旅程在群山中继续向前。

senses.en: moving or directed forward

example.en: The train made its onward journey to the coast.
example.zh: 火车继续向海岸行进。

senses.en: warm, friendly, and polite

example.en: They maintained a cordial relationship after the meeting.
example.zh: 会后他们保持着友好融洽的关系。

senses.en: a sweet fruit-flavored drink or liqueur
senses.zh: 甜果汁饮料；（餐后）甜味利口酒

example.en: She offered the guests a glass of fruit cordial.
example.zh: 她请客人喝了一杯果汁甜饮。

senses.en: firm and determined in purpose

example.en: She remained resolute despite the criticism.
example.zh: 尽管受到批评，她依然坚定不移。

senses.en: until now or until a particular time

example.en: The technique had hitherto been considered impossible.
example.zh: 这种技术此前一直被认为是不可能的。

senses.en: a plant of the mint family, such as lemon balm

example.en: Melissa is often grown in gardens for its lemon-scented leaves.
example.zh: 蜜蜂花常被种在花园里，因为它的叶子有柠檬香味。

senses.en: a female given name

example.en: Melissa joined our team last month.
example.zh: 梅丽莎上个月加入了我们的团队。

senses.en: the quality of being determined and not changing one's decision

example.en: She answered with firmness that she would not change her mind.
example.zh: 她坚定地回答说她不会改变主意。

senses.en: the quality of being solid and not easily moved or changed in shape

example.en: The firmness of the new mattress made it very comfortable.
example.zh: 新床垫的结实程度让它非常舒适。

senses.en: coins and banknotes used as a medium of exchange

example.en: I paid for the tickets in cash because I had enough money with me.
example.zh: 我身上带了足够的钱，所以用现金付了票款。

senses.en: wealth or financial resources in general

example.en: Her new business is losing money in its first year.
example.zh: 她的新生意第一年在亏钱。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms, usually for a short time

example.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the station.
example.zh: 我们住在车站附近的一家小旅馆。

senses.en: a place where goods are sold

example.en: There is a small shop near the station.
example.zh: 车站附近有一家小商店。

senses.en: a place where things are made or repaired

example.en: The car is being repaired in the shop.
example.zh: 汽车正在车间里修理。

senses.en: to buy goods in stores

example.en: We shop for groceries every weekend.
example.zh: 我们每个周末都要买食品杂货。

senses.en: feeling very happy and enthusiastic

example.en: The kids were excited about the trip to the beach.
example.zh: 孩子们对去海滩的旅行感到很兴奋。

senses.en: physically or emotionally aroused

example.en: The crowd grew excited as the game neared its end.
example.zh: 比赛接近尾声时，人群变得激动起来。

senses.en: to draw something again, often with changes

example.en: The committee voted to redraw the district boundaries.
example.zh: 委员会投票决定重新划定地区边界。

senses.en: loyal, reliable, and strong

example.en: She remained a stalwart supporter of the club for years.
example.zh: 多年来她一直是该俱乐部坚定的支持者。

senses.en: a loyal, reliable supporter of a group or cause

example.en: Party stalwarts gathered for the annual meeting.
example.zh: 该党的忠实成员参加了年会。

senses.en: a short summary of the main points of a story or argument

example.en: The agent asked her to send a one-page synopsis of her novel.
example.zh: 经纪人请她寄一份一页纸的小说梗概。

senses.en: a piece of classical music, usually with three or four movements, for one or two instruments

example.en: She played a Beethoven piano sonata at the recital.
example.zh: 她在独奏会上演奏了一首贝多芬钢琴奏鸣曲。

senses.en: a person who preaches the Christian gospel

example.en: The evangelist spoke to crowds in the town square.
example.zh: 福音传道者在镇广场向人群讲道。

senses.en: (capitalized) one of the four traditional authors of the Gospels: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John
senses.zh: （大写）福音书作者（马太、马可、路加、约翰）

example.en: The four Evangelists are depicted in the church windows.
example.zh: 教堂彩窗上描绘了四位福音书作者。

senses.en: the organ fish use to breathe underwater

example.en: Fish take in oxygen through their gills.
example.zh: 鱼通过鳃摄取氧气。

senses.en: a unit of liquid measure equal to about 142 ml (UK) or 118 ml (US)

example.en: The recipe calls for half a gill of cream.
example.zh: 这份食谱需要半及耳奶油。

senses.en: (British English, informal) a man or boy

example.en: He seems like a friendly chap.
example.zh: 他看起来是个友好的小伙子。

senses.en: to make skin rough, dry and cracked

example.en: Cold wind chaps your lips.
example.zh: 冷风会使嘴唇皲裂。

senses.en: a small brush with a long handle used to clean the teeth

example.en: Replace your toothbrush every three months.
example.zh: 每三个月换一次牙刷。

collocations: brush your teeth with a toothbrush

senses.en: to rush around violently and destructively

example.en: The elephant rampaged through the village.
example.zh: 大象在村子里横冲直撞。

senses.en: a period of violent, destructive behavior

example.en: The crowd went on a rampage after the match.
example.zh: 比赛结束后人群开始闹事。

senses.en: progress toward achieving something

example.en: The team is finally making headway on the project.
example.zh: 团队终于在这个项目上取得了进展。

senses.en: forward movement of a ship or vehicle

example.en: The ship struggled to make headway against the strong current.
example.zh: 船在湍急的水流中艰难前行。

senses.en: an organized criminal group, especially the Sicilian or Italian-American one

example.en: The police investigated links between the company and the mafia.
example.zh: 警方调查了该公司与黑手党之间的联系。

senses.en: an informal, powerful group that controls or influences something
senses.zh: （某领域内结党营私的）小集团

example.en: Critics say a small elite mafia controls the funding.
example.zh: 批评者说一小撮精英小集团控制着资金。

senses.en: the musical sol-fa syllable between fa and la
senses.zh: （音乐唱名）sol，位于 fa 与 la 之间

example.en: The class sang do, re, mi, fa, sol.
example.zh: 全班唱了 do、re、mi、fa、sol。

senses.en: the basic unit of money in Peru

example.en: The ticket cost ten soles.
example.zh: 这张票花了十索尔。

senses.en: a young plant grown from a seed

example.en: She planted the tomato seedlings in the garden.
example.zh: 她把番茄幼苗种在花园里。

senses.en: a large bird with a fan-shaped tail, often raised for food

example.en: We saw a turkey on the farm.
example.zh: 我们在农场看到了一只火鸡。

senses.en: the meat of this bird, often eaten at holidays

example.en: They served turkey for dinner.
example.zh: 他们晚餐吃了火鸡肉。

senses.en: a film, play, or other product that is a failure
senses.zh: 失败的作品；不受欢迎的东西

example.en: The new show was a complete turkey.
example.zh: 这部新剧彻底失败了。

senses.en: (capitalized: Turkey) a country in western Asia and southeastern Europe, also called Türkiye
senses.zh: 土耳其（国名，首字母大写；亦作 Türkiye）

example.en: She visited Turkey last summer.
example.zh: 她去年夏天去了土耳其。

senses.en: a tool with a handle and prongs used for eating or serving food

example.en: She used a fork to eat the salad.
example.zh: 她用叉子吃沙拉。

senses.en: a place where a road, river, or branch divides into two or more parts

example.en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
example.zh: 在岔路口向左转。

senses.en: to divide into two or more branches or parts

example.en: The path forks just beyond the bridge.
example.zh: 小路在桥那边不远处分叉。

senses.en: to lift or move something with a fork
senses.zh: 用叉子叉起；用叉子翻动

example.en: He forked the hay into the cart.
example.zh: 他用叉子把干草叉上车。

senses.en: the branch of biology that studies how organisms interact with each other and their environment

example.en: She studied ecology at university to learn how forests and animals depend on each other.
example.zh: 她在大学学习生态学，以了解森林和动物如何相互依存。

senses.en: the relationships between living things and their environment, or the state of an ecosystem

example.en: Pollution has damaged the ecology of the lake.
example.zh: 污染破坏了这片湖泊的生态。

senses.en: a female god or deity

example.en: Athena was the goddess of wisdom in Greek mythology.
example.zh: 在希腊神话中，雅典娜是智慧女神。

senses.en: a woman greatly admired or beloved

example.en: Fans treated the singer like a goddess.
example.zh: 歌迷们把这位歌手当作女神一样崇拜。

senses.en: to make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or self-conscious

example.en: His joke accidentally embarrassed her in front of the class.
example.zh: 他的玩笑无意间让她在全班面前感到尴尬。

senses.en: the act or process of moving faster, or an increase in speed

example.en: The acceleration of the car impressed everyone.
example.zh: 这辆车的加速性能让所有人都印象深刻。

senses.en: the rate at which velocity changes over time (physics)

example.en: Gravity causes an acceleration of about 9.8 m/s² on Earth.
example.zh: 重力使地球上的加速度约为9.8米/秒²。

senses.en: the speeding up of a process or development

example.en: The project saw an acceleration after new funding arrived.
example.zh: 新资金到位后，项目进度加快了。

senses.en: a person who steals things from others

example.en: A thief broke into the car and stole the radio.
example.zh: 一个小偷撬开了汽车，偷走了收音机。

senses.en: someone who does an activity for enjoyment rather than as a job

example.en: She is an amateur photographer who takes pictures on weekends.
example.zh: 她是一名业余摄影师，周末会去拍照。

senses.en: a person who is not professional or skilled; a beginner

example.en: In cooking, he is a complete amateur.
example.zh: 在烹饪方面，他完全是个外行。

senses.en: done for enjoyment rather than as a paid job

example.en: He plays in an amateur football league.
example.zh: 他在一个业余足球联赛中踢球。

senses.en: lacking professional skill; unprofessional

example.en: The repair work looked amateur.
example.zh: 这修理活儿看起来很外行。

senses.en: not following traditional customs, methods, or roles
senses.zh: 非传统的；不符合传统的

example.en: They chose a nontraditional wedding ceremony on the beach.
example.zh: 他们选择了一场在海滩上举行的非传统婚礼。

senses.en: to change from frozen to liquid or soft; to unfreeze

example.en: Leave the frozen chicken to thaw overnight in the fridge.
example.zh: 把冷冻鸡肉放在冰箱里冷藏解冻过夜。

senses.en: to become friendlier or less formal

example.en: Relations between the two countries began to thaw after the talks.
example.zh: 会谈后，两国关系开始缓和。

senses.en: a period of warm weather when snow and ice melt

example.en: The spring thaw flooded the fields.
example.zh: 春季解冻淹没了田地。

senses.en: a joke or funny remark

example.en: The comedian opened his show with a quick gag.
example.zh: 喜剧演员用一个简短的笑话开场。

senses.en: something put in someone's mouth to stop them speaking

example.en: The story mentions that the hostage had a gag in his mouth.
example.zh: 据报道，人质的嘴里被塞了封口物。

senses.en: to stop someone from speaking or expressing opinions freely

example.en: Critics accused the government of trying to gag the press.
example.zh: 批评者指责政府试图压制新闻自由。

senses.en: to have a feeling of almost vomiting

example.en: The strong smell made her gag.
example.zh: 那股刺鼻的气味让她直想吐。

senses.en: a fixed amount of food or supplies allowed to each person, especially in times of shortage

example.en: During the war, each family received a weekly bread ration.
example.zh: 战争期间，每个家庭每周领取一份面包配给。

senses.en: to limit the amount of something each person can have or use

example.en: Water was rationed during the long drought.
example.zh: 长期干旱期间，用水实行了定量供应。

senses.en: to clean something so as to destroy bacteria and other germs

example.en: Please disinfect the surfaces before preparing food.
example.zh: 备餐前请给台面消毒。

senses.en: a short film about current events, shown in cinemas in the past

example.en: Moviegoers watched the newsreel before the main film.
example.zh: 观众在正片放映前观看了新闻短片。

senses.en: a person who makes or sells jewelry

example.en: The jeweler repaired my broken necklace.
example.zh: 珠宝匠修好了我损坏的项链。

senses.en: a narrow crack or opening, especially in rock or a wall

example.en: Small plants grew in the crevices of the stone wall.
example.zh: 石墙的裂缝里长出了小植物。

senses.en: to limit or restrict something within bounds

example.en: Strict rules circumscribe what the committee can decide.
example.zh: 严格的规定限制了委员会的决策范围。

senses.en: to draw a line or shape around something

example.en: The students were asked to circumscribe a circle around the triangle.
example.zh: 学生们被要求在三角形外画一个外接圆。

senses.en: a person who leaves school or a course before finishing it (also written dropout)

example.en: The school's drop-out rate has fallen this year.
example.zh: 今年学校的辍学率下降了。

senses.en: a temporary loss of signal or data in a recording or transmission (technical)
senses.zh: 信号丢失；数据漏失（技术术语）

example.en: The audio has a brief drop-out in the middle.
example.zh: 音频中间有一小段信号丢失。

senses.en: speaking or moving in an affectedly delicate or refined way
senses.zh: 矫揉造作的；装腔作势的

example.en: He gave a mincing little bow before speaking.
example.zh: 他说话前做作地微微鞠了一躬。

senses.en: a kind or category of thing

example.en: There are many types of birds in this forest.
example.zh: 这片森林里有许多种类的鸟。

senses.en: people of a particular kind or character

example.en: The club attracts quiet, thoughtful types.
example.zh: 这个俱乐部吸引了安静、善于思考的人。

senses.en: to write using a keyboard

example.en: He types quickly on his laptop.
example.zh: 他在笔记本电脑上打字很快。
